protocol.cache_definition: standalone exactly T tokens, Ns=ceil(T/1024); no decode capacity added
protocol.timing: existing cuda_ms; Stage 1 + unchanged Stage 2; compile/allocation/validation/metadata excluded; warm same-cache steady-state; no cache flush
protocol.data: existing frozen quantizer on seeded synthetic physical FP16 pages, randomized block table shared by both representations and every g; no new model or dataset
protocol.correctness: relative L2 versus own representation legacy g1 <=0.002 and finite; INT4 g6 versus existing grouped (non-power-of-two padding repair) <=0.002; smoke additionally checked against chunked FP32 softmax oracle
protocol.primary: paired process/round GI=I1-Ig, GF=F1-Fg, D=GI-GF in ms; report raw effects/ranges without significance threshold
protocol.g1_sanity: raw generalized/legacy ratio by shape/process/round; before full model manual source review if repeatable material drift; no posthoc numeric gate
protocol.selection: after valid low-level review freeze one best fixed g per representation minimizing equal-weight geometric mean latency across all 24 shapes and all processes/rounds; tie chooses smaller g; commit policy before full-model
protocol.fullmodel: only after low-level validity; reuse E09 held-out prose stream, original native GDN/all64layers/onlineappend/LMhead/teacherforcing; no calibration or layer search
nonclaims: no total-work-only conclusion from W1 alone: equal W1 also holds B*T constant so KV footprint and work are confounded

note: Existing grouped path padded to power of two for Q_PER_KV=6; no nibble or merge changes
